title: Why Does Challenging Anger Bring More Anger?
fullTitle: Soul Snack #57: Why Does Challenging Anger Bring More Anger?

promo.text: Create the life you desire by choosing love over fear. Learn how HERE .

description: Each irritating encounter or judgmental thought becomes an opportunity to strengthen your authentic power and to choose love over fear.

Gary shares that anger is not an external force but an energy that arises from a frightened part of your personality. By recognizing the physical sensations – tightness in your chest, tension in your throat, or heat in your solar plexus – you can begin to observe your anger rather than act from it. This awareness transforms destructive reactions into conscious choices that align with your soul’s intention.

When you stop blaming and judging and instead reach for gratitude, patience, and compassion, anger begins to lose its control over you. What once felt like chaos and conflict becomes a practice ground for spiritual mastery and co-creation with the universe.
What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

This week, notice when anger arises. Instead of reacting or suppressing it, pause and observe where you feel it in your body. Ask yourself: What fear might be underneath this? Then consciously reach for gratitude, patience, or compassion. Each time you do this, you dissolve a layer of fear and move closer to living in authentic power.
